rationale: Per IEC 60909: summed positive-sequence impedances (R=0.032 pu, X=0.261 pu). I_base = 100/(√3×10.5) = 5.4986 kA. Ik_max = 1.1/0.262954 × I_base = 23.00 kA; Sk_max = √3×10.5×23.00 = 418.3 MVA. Ik_min = 1.0/0.263610 × I_base = 20.86 kA (with 0.005 pu fault resistance added for minimum current case).
